HyperFrames v0.8.218

Released on 2026-10-29.

The CLI now signs in with its own HyperFrames account link, separate from the HeyGen CLI. Run hyperframes auth login once after upgrading, and cloud work then bills to your HyperFrames plan.

Features

  • CLI: The CLI signs in with its own HyperFrames OAuth client and keeps its login apart from the HeyGen CLI, so one tool's sign-in no longer overwrites the other's. Existing users sign in again once. A HEYGEN_API_KEY still works as before (3e462f427, #6687).

item.title: v0.8.217
item.description:
HyperFrames v0.8.217

Released on 2026-10-29.

The preview no longer hangs when a scene cannot close. Render errors name the kind of missing file, never its path, and a project .env only sets the CLI's own settings.

Features

  • CLI: A render that finds a file missing says which kind of file, never its path (943849025, #6742).
  • CLI: A feedback report names why the last check failed (eab6541f5, #6717).

Fixes

  • CLI: A project .env only sets the CLI's own settings (838f8782c, #6565).
  • Core: The preview's scene window settles when a scene can't unmount instead of hanging the page (93f3d3dcb, #6740).
  • CLI: Allow-occlusion on the covering element silences text_occluded (1a80b5407, #6741).
  • Engine: Long films show progress during the effect check and never wait minutes on it (e1a8c7f17, #6697).
  • CLI: A failed render's code comes only from the producer's list of safe codes (0da46832e, #6737).
  • Core: Telemetry redaction covers folders with spaces in any script (71f716a91, #6734).
  • CLI: Snapshot says FFmpeg was stopped when it exits 255 with no output (94203ad43, #6718).

Full changelog

item.title: v0.8.216
item.description:
HyperFrames v0.8.216

Released on 2026-10-29.

This release carries every change from v0.8.215, which never reached npm. iPhone Safari keeps every take's sound, multi-worker renders land each frame in place, and encoding runs faster.

Features

  • Telemetry: Identify signed-in CLI users by their HyperFrames user id, and say signed-in usage is not anonymous (1c3fcf4d2, #6703).
  • Producer: Report which element set the film length (3ca1005a8, #6689).

Fixes

  • Player: iPhone Safari keeps every take's sound after the first seconds of an edit (48ba0e5b2, #6724).
  • AWS Lambda: The release ffmpeg build falls back to verified mirrors when a source host is down (f0665f718, #6728).
  • CLI: A failed render names its failure code for the Desktop app (ba8ffffa0, #6725).
  • CLI: A snapshot still shows what playback shows, whatever other times are asked for (cf1589242, #6720).
  • CLI: The lint summary points at hyperframes lint, not a flag only render takes (98a28cc4b, #6723).
  • Ci: Skills sync steps past the five hidden ClawHub versions blocking it (49e031230, #6713).
  • CLI: An unknown command like search says which command does that (bb4deb801, #6710).
  • CLI: Check says how many browser-playable copies are done while it makes them (2f8c4b1da, #6712).
  • Core: A multi-worker or chunked render lands every frame where an in-order render does (fa9acbd73, #6707).
  • CLI: Check says a lint error is why the browser pass was skipped (11312b359, #6709).
  • CLI: Capture names the network's proxy when it refuses the connection to the site (f0c5db6ea, #6706).
  • CLI: Check waits as long as the --timeout it was given before it counts as idle (6c1765933, #6705).
  • CLI: Audio windows read beats off the whole clip; beats snap to the signal and mark silence (4fa5f5451, #6692).
  • Producer: A BeginFrame capture that draws no first frame in 20 s switches to screenshot (a5496b188, #6701).
  • CLI: Media-treatment --capability preset finds the presets area (cfa653af4, #6700).
  • CLI: A Windows render no longer prints taskkill's already-exited message (ac449555f, #6698).
  • CLI: Snapshot reads https video in the Desktop app instead of failing at ffprobe (0620067eb, #6699).
  • CLI: A stopped model download resumes on the next run instead of starting over (81959201f, #6694).
  • CLI: Media-treatment finds an area by the name its overview prints (2c3d1e07f, #6675).
  • Engine: Downloads refuse hosts that resolve to private addresses (9830059bd, #6571).
  • CLI: Check no longer reports outline text as not painted (9f65efb19, #6693).
  • CLI: Beats --json answers with no track when the composition has no music (ec10aae54, #6690).
  • Core: Graded media honors object-position vertically instead of mirroring it (aa4a71fe4, #6691).
  • Studio: Audio keeps playing after a timeline move or trim in a static composition (9aa6346a7, #6428).
  • Engine: A render from an app that bundles the engine stamps the engine's version (cdc86117c, #6686).
  • Studio: An undo or redo counts as a preview change from its key, not from its reload (710314c15, #6683).
  • Producer: A capture that landed every frame is not failed for the work after its last frame (067cbf7ac, #6674).
  • CLI: Check no longer treats a transparent canvas as covering the frame (203a08dd7, #6681).
  • Core: Grade groups resolve per composition; freeze frames keep their lane (c569760a7, #6685).

Performance

  • Engine: Encode high quality with the x264 fast preset (be05c8693, #6640).
  • Engine: Size render workers from measured heap and the container's CPU quota (cd003e201, #6641).
  • Producer: The audio true-peak check seeks to each segment instead of decoding up to it (c2cde2fb6, #6672).

Docs & Examples

  • CLI: Say which audio probes run once per file (5d437d5ee, #6731).
  • CLI: List check's audio findings with severity, trigger and fix (fa97f9d4b, #6730).

Catalog

  • Skills: The registry skill says its commands are catalog and add (1428f8768, #6680).

Internal

  • One regression shard writes the test image cache (74f323473, #6729).
  • CLI: The publish abort test checks the summary hint is absent (077de9bfe, #6726).

Full changelog

item.title: v0.8.213
item.description:
HyperFrames v0.8.213

Released on 2026-10-28.

Videos that start late in a clip now render every frame the preview shows. Fonts in a linked stylesheet are bundled, website capture stops on its own, and check and snapshot read each file once.

Fixes

  • Core: Bundled fonts in a linked stylesheet or a font shorthand are seen by the bundler (67c7ec27d, #6665).
  • CLI: Website capture ends with what it has instead of running until it is killed (5b5633fbb, #6662).
  • Core: A preview media load that fails is reported, not swallowed (cf627a861, #6666).
  • CLI: Snapshot decodes each video once for all the times it shows (cd3b90d1e, #6667).
  • CLI: Check treats text inside a closed details element as not rendered (a1733f4e4, #6669).
  • CLI: Check probes each audio file once, however many clips are cut from it (8fe0ce660, #6654).
  • Studio: A timeline edit on a clip the file lacks says how the clip was looked up (40c28e10d, #6661).
  • CLI: A late teardown error no longer turns a finished command into exit 1 (5a9fdd524, #6659).
  • Engine: Late-starting MP4 and WebM videos render every frame the preview shows (437784038, #6664).
  • Audio: A sound is voice only with a voice-range pitch, judged on the whole clip (1df31d871, #6653).

Internal

  • Producer: Stall test no longer waits a real second for the progress flush (6486d5802, #6658).
  • Engine: The multi-chunk encode test gets the 30 s the other ffmpeg tests have (4db1214e7, #6663).

Full changelog

item.title: v0.8.212
item.description:
HyperFrames v0.8.212

Released on 2026-10-28.

A model download that stalls now resumes instead of failing. Failures with --json answer in one shape, and check shows progress as it runs.

Fixes

  • CLI: Exit 2 for remaining flag validation errors (2d3033c71, #6639).
  • CLI: Snapshot warns when a video on screen has no source to read a frame from (b84762230, #6656).
  • CLI: Every --json failure answers with one envelope, and --json only where supported (85efaece7, #6622).
  • CLI: A check page forces a WebGL drawing buffer but keeps no list of 2d canvases (b6eaed7ca, #6650).
  • Inspector: Live queries see every composition, wherever the playhead is (205c1a31d, #6651).
  • CLI: Resume a model download that stalls partway instead of failing (ecad35a22, #6649).
  • Studio: A thumbnail reader forgets a start's failures after a minute (a88751d9d, #6642).
  • Studio Server: The render route passes a MOV ProRes profile to the render (5a0179b88, #6644).
  • Engine: A Windows browser that will not start says where and why (7758d9b8f, #6647).
  • CLI: Add help [cmd], suggest the closest command or flag, and quiet the nags (e2c915132, #6621).
  • CLI: Check prints a progress line as each pass after overlap begins (3d1c0764a, #6646).

Internal

  • Studio: Wait for the first undo press before the edit that should block the second (7112e4b6b, #6652).
  • Keep the bun cache warm and skip binary downloads in preflight (0e32ee9b5, #6648).

Full changelog

  • Codegen: Resync cloud client from EF 354b4cf4 (32e171ca9, #6608).

item.title: v0.8.210
item.description:
HyperFrames v0.8.210

Released on 2026-10-27.

MOV renders can now pick a ProRes profile, and HDR sources render correctly to formats that cannot carry HDR. A page whose renderer crashes now fails at once with a clear reason instead of hanging.

Features

  • CLI: Render --prores-profile picks ProRes 4444, hq, 422, lt or proxy for MOV (957df5c268c66, #6581).
  • CLI: Doctor names the tested ffmpeg build and says loudness is only comparable on it (98e774384efdc, #6566).

Fixes

  • CLI: A page whose renderer crashes fails at once, named as the crash (439d6856780f0, #6598).
  • Producer: HDR sources are tone-mapped for formats that cannot carry HDR (313792408d641, #6597).
  • Engine: Extraction waits out the decode up to a deep seek in a long-GOP video (3b2058a2b7a2e, #6583).
  • Preview: The proxy copy for the video at the playhead is made ahead of the rest (bff39004b0312, #6586).
  • CLI: Hyperframes add keeps going when Windows holds the file it replaces (e21fd123fd8f8, #6576).
  • CLI: A killed remove-background run no longer leaves its CoreML temp files behind (0a703edc6f119, #6582).
  • Engine: Mux uppercase WebM exports with Opus audio (1d4aadc1fb436, #6579).
  • Producer: Stop HDR video windows after the first from repeating one frame (07b0f2cda1cf7, #6575).
  • CLI: Check fails a full-frame element that covers every other clip, naming it (2a0fa7f4de970, #6572).
  • CLI: A failed --against reference no longer also says it has no frame (696ca8f779cd3, #6574).
  • AWS Lambda: A network blip no longer stops the release ffmpeg build (8cd9c517c79be, #6569).
  • CLI: Capture waits for a mid-read navigation to settle and reads the page again once (013fe4e18ad7c, #6567).
  • CLI: A capture DNS helper that dies silently says how it ended (d571d77cae9d8, #6570).
  • Studio: Keep the canvas outline off the scaled preview iframe (624c9becfde73, #6452).
  • CLI: A snapshot clip whose frame fails is named with ffmpeg's reason (7a0c75bb69925, #6564).
  • CLI: A nearer copy of another version no longer hides the host's pinned onnxruntime-node (5561640809154, #6563).

Docs & Examples

  • Link the free lessons from the docs (0163ee11a75a3, #6588).
  • Links point at hyperframes.studio, the app's new home (6ae7c7688cec2, #6585).

Internal

  • No change-detection or reachability checkout can run into the one-minute limit (7fea875ede12d, #6577).
  • Engine: The test Chrome warms its first page in beforeAll; browser hooks get 30 s (c391b50163d0f, #6568).
  • CLI: Chrome-driving tests run in their own project after the rest (9b9dd7665499a, #6560).

  • Core: An audio clip that never gets data no longer freezes the playhead (33e0ba550b4e6, #6523).

  • CLI: --timeout on check and snapshot takes units like 45s (a669316bf2f8e, #6521).

Performance

  • Producer: A parallel chunk checks BeginFrame on its first worker, with no separate browser (69892716001f9, #6500).

  • A release PR runs a fast release check instead of the heavy suites (d94132e60979a, #6524).
  • CLI: The studio server test reads the asset body it fetches before moving the folder (c9377e28ff642, #6528).

Released on 2026-10-26.

  • CLI: Check catches audio the render would lose or play as silence (d83bf997b0b6b, #6439).

  • Render: A PNG's colour tags no longer change its pixels in preview, check, snapshot or render (3e16603d3769d, #6453).

  • CLI: Hide the Windows console for the port lookup and clipboard (37543d223a535, #6449).
  • Core: A composition behind a wrapper takes its host's start (0979e32a8dd7c, #6435).
  • CLI: Validate play and present ports (0cc14ddb8ec1a, #6402).
  • Engine: Name the element a failing root composition script looked up (83a29e9209df8, #6430).

  • Studio: A scrub's state messages re-read the preview's compositions at most every 500 ms (121bf20e99da6, #6429).

  • Lint: Cover three caption rules that had no tests (95aba51e205ef, #5436).

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.8.193

Released on 2026-10-24.

Cloud renders of long, cut-heavy edits finish several times faster at the same or lower cost. Audio renders work again on FFmpeg 4.4.

Fixes

  • Engine: Audio encodes on FFmpeg 4.4, which has no setts duration option (3d45d1b037860, #6219).
  • CLI: Each start sweeps the running markers of CLIs that are gone (24965372dbbec, #5790).
  • CLI: Snapshot rejects a negative --at and builds its sheet from its own frames (80be6ff039bb7, #6179).
  • CLI: Snapshot seeks into a HEVC cut whose index lands a keyframe early (3cbd98890e6f6, #6217).
  • Studio Server: A history restore refuses to remove every tracked file (0eae4946d33f3, #6175).
  • Engine: Disable Dawn's DXC on Windows so WebGPU requestDevice succeeds (3dc0b97bfdfe3, #5830).
  • Studio: A scene swap no longer keeps the previous preview window in memory (291144e87ddfe, #6207).
  • Core: Color grading builds a new WebGL context when a lost one is never restored (700187b855de3, #6211).
  • Producer: A render's page-error count includes what the capture workers saw (1ab871fb117aa, #6196).
  • Engine: Renames ride out Windows file locks instead of failing the render (0a8a78edec413, #6210).

Performance

  • AWS Lambda: Cloud renders plan without reading video bytes and start chunks sooner (da4386f0d0695, #6194).

Docs & Examples

  • Skills: Say which font faces are bundled and which are fetched (8811f0bfbf3e7, #6197).

Internal

  • CLI: The lifecycle suite lets background imports settle before it resets modules (dd1cba49de4e1, #6216).
  • The lifecycle and thumbnail suites load cold modules in a hook, not in their first test (1a238171ec558, #6212).

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.8.185

Released on 2026-10-21.

hyperframes cloud render --resolution 4k now works for transparent MOV and WebM. A render no longer fails when its audio peak stalls under correction, check accepts projects that inline the GSAP library, and cloud render chunks start their capture browsers while video frames extract. Capture motion blur arrives as an opt-in on the composition root.

Features

  • CLI: cloud render --resolution 4k accepts --format mov and --format webm; the CLI and the render server no longer refuse 4K with a transparent format (25126bca6, #6045).
  • Core: Capture motion blur: data-motion-blur on the composition root blurs fast-moving elements across sub-frame samples, with shutter angle and sample count settings (0f1d6908f, #5967); it follows the render's device scale, so 2x and 4K renders blur at full resolution (ffcef8f88, #5968).

Fixes

  • Producer: A render whose AAC true peak stalls above the limit during correction no longer fails at assemble (32ebdde61, #6043).
  • Lint: check no longer fails a project that pastes the GSAP library inline, and a bundle around GSAP never inherits its exemption (50e7e8df6, #6018).
  • Engine: A capture browser whose BeginFrame probe passed keeps BeginFrame capture when closing the probe page is slow (a8b576d15, #6037).

Performance

  • Producer: A cloud render chunk starts its capture browsers while its video frames are still being extracted, so heavy chunks finish sooner and cost less (0716670fa, #6031).

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.8.184

Released on 2026-10-21.

hyperframes cloud render now takes projects whose media is far larger than the project upload limit. Multi-worker mp4 renders start encoding while they capture, Lambda chunks run more capture browsers at once, and a heavy project's preview builds faster. Transparent webm keeps its transparency in Studio previews, and a color grade applies to an image that appears after its scene starts hidden.

Features

  • CLI: cloud render uploads media of 5 MB or more as hosted assets before zipping the project, so projects with media far larger than the upload limit render with no manual step. Uploads are cached, so a re-render sends only new or changed media (b306438e8, #5931).

  • Producer: A cloud plan can leave its audio out and build that track on its own, which the Lambda change above uses (8b410f1cb, #5988).
  • Registry: New echo-smear component: a streak of copies that trails an element as a GSAP timeline moves it faster (23e7a384b, #5980).

  • CLI: check prints progress while it makes browser-playable copies of phone videos (b7fa007bf, #5953).
  • CLI: check, snapshot and Studio show accented and non-Latin project text correctly instead of garbled (6d357ff0d, #5843).

  • CLI: check audits a color-graded video as the video it shows, so the video's layout opt-outs apply and its footage is not read as cut-off text (9f793a6db, #5963).
  • CLI: A scoped keepsMoving check ignores a changing page background outside its scope (ba1fa8b12, #5966).
  • Lint: check and lint place each scene's audio at its host's start, so scenes that play one after another no longer warn of overlapping audio (18207de1c, #6005).
  • CLI: The Chrome the CLI launches exits with it, even when the CLI is killed (434ad8c41, #5943).
  • CLI: snapshot, compare and check wait for images that load late, as render does, so their frames show what the rendered video shows (f440db901, #5977).
  • CLI: A finished capture exits even when a site's DNS never answers, instead of staying alive until the system lookup gives up (128973477, #5983).

  • Engine: A cloud render whose audio read from a file's link is cut off fails with an error the render retries, instead of shipping the rest of the clip silent (b4e63cf19, #5996).
  • Engine: Renders use the browser the CLI picked when both browser settings are set, and Linux renders on system Chrome no longer take the parallel capture path meant for headless-shell (0260c40e5, #5987).
  • Core: Audio volume automation stays correct when the browser refuses an overlapping curve (e44f456b7, #5927).
  • Player: An embed that sets no height shows its film at the film's shape instead of 0 px tall (46cb5ca44, #5932).
  • Inspector: Component reports show the animation code inside large wrappers and only the film's own files (bbb691001, #5989).
  • Inspector: A component report that runs out of room keeps the code that makes the animations ahead of CSS rules (41af1add0, #6003).
  • Inspector: A component report spends less of its size budget on fixed text and repeated file names, so more of the film's code fits (1d422a2fa, #6016).
  • Inspector: A component report also shows the composition and host tags that set a matched element's timing (05315a14b, #6015).
  • Catalog: Seven component previews that showed dark text on a black canvas render in their demo's theme, in the Catalog and after hyperframes add (b16d5a706, #5995).
  • AWS Lambda: lambda sites create and Lambda renders upload source files over 2 GiB and over 5 GB (c8f322c25, #5964).
  • Skills: A storyboard leaves the film as it was until the person says go, so the preview no longer plays the posed stills as a slideshow (6590d5670, #5982).

  • CLI: Commands run without loading esbuild, puppeteer-core or sharp until they need them (5583ae429, #5930).
  • CLI: Commands start sooner by compiling registry schemas on first use (d898ad89e, #5935).
  • CLI: check splits its samples over a second Chrome when a core and memory are spare (952c6ba1c, #5896).
  • CLI: A repeat check from an agent is served by a check process that already has the CLI loaded and Chrome running (434ad8c41, #5943).
  • Engine: Cloud renders take a video's audio from the stretch the edit uses, read from its link, instead of downloading the whole file (a8a80323f, #5972).
  • Producer: Local renders check the audio peak in parallel segments, as cloud plans do (e319e6449, #5942).
  • Producer: Renders the fast capture refuses keep their parallel workers instead of being pinned to one or three (30f514b13, #5945).
  • Producer: A cloud plan whose mixed audio peaks too high corrects it from the mix itself, in parallel segments, so the plan is faster and the audio closer to the mix (a125dbc19, #5981).
  • Producer: Cloud render chunks hand Chrome each video near the size it is drawn, so a 4K camera shown small no longer costs a full 4K frame on every frame (7cc5dd382, #6001).

Internal

  • Four timing tests stop failing on slow Windows runners (f98ef09be, #5949).
  • Studio's real-Chrome tests recover from a stuck Chrome launch or close (234ebc4ba, #5961).
  • Cloud download tests use small parts so a slow Windows loopback cannot time them out (852f6f9f6, #5999).
  • The Chrome orphan test waits for Chrome to exit instead of a fixed 5 s (00d55a7f1, #5986).
  • The package size check on every PR now measures what a release publishes, so a release can no longer pass review and then fail to publish on size (ccc13c3b5, #6017).
  • The generated catalog is republished (908f2d095, #5540).
  • Two lint tests that always failed on Windows now pass there (178eea563, #5579).
